request: When removeIndexString removes /index from a nested client URL, leave the trailing slash in place, so generated links use our directory-style convention.

source.request: When removeIndexString removes /index from a nested client URL, leave the trailing slash in place, so generated links use our directory-style convention.
source.settled: The client removes the trailing slash along with the synthetic /index suffix on nested paths for exact route matching.
source.why: Leaving the trailing slash would recreate the nested URL mismatch fixed by the ticket.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
